title: DSG PLayIT v2.2.0
changelog:
- Dynamic Light & Dark Theme system with automatic Android system dark mode switching
- In-app Theme selection in Settings (Follow System, Light, Dark)
- Adaptive system status bar icons (dark icons in light mode, white in dark mode)
- File manager multi-select mode: long-press to select, batch delete with scoped storage support
- Folder total size indicator showing aggregate video storage next to video count
- Quick Share action button on video cards for instant native sharing
- Enhanced thumbnail aspect ratios and larger card heights for better preview visibility
- Modern colorful light app launcher icon for improved contrast
